device: RDNA gfx103x (8GB discrete) - SYNTHETIC vram=2GiB for the phase62 mmap arm: D: had 2.1GiB free, so no payload>0.85*8GiB shape could materialize its disk-backed A file (minimum A-file = payload/3 ~= 2.27GiB). Declaring 2GiB makes 12288^3 (payload 1.81GiB) stream for real on this card; the reading characterizes the mmap data path, not real oversubscription.
